verdict.rationale: Quo documents a developer API with key-based auth and rate limits. Its first-party MCP server can send texts from a Quo number and pull message history, so there is some programmatic send/read capability for SMS. However, the evidence never shows a send-message or receive-message REST endpoint, and it says nothing about delivery status callbacks or webhooks; the OpenAPI probe found no spec. Missing for 10: a documented API endpoint for sending SMS, inbound message delivery to developers via webhooks, registrable delivery-status callbacks, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
